newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to send troika to Belarus.
newsitem.headline: EU to send troika to Belarus.

text.p: The European Union agreed on Monday to send a fact-finding mission to Belarus whose flirtation with Moscow following a controversial referendum has sparked concern in the West.

EU foreign ministers said the mission, led by the current Dutch presidency, would try and report on the legality of the November 24 vote which greatly expanded the powers of President Alexander Lukashenko.
After the vote, Lukashenko -- who favours a renewed economic union with Russia -- used his greatly enhanced powers to dissolve parliament and replace it with a legislature packed with his supporters.

A statement issued by the General Affairs Council (GAC) said the mission would also try and gauge the health of democracy in the country and in particular if opponents were subject to harassment by the authorities.

Russian President Boris Yeltsin has also set alarm bells ringing in the West by calling for a merger between the two countries in a move widely seen as a response to NATO's plans to take new members from former communist Europe.
Moscow has frequently said it may have to respond to enlargement by creating its own new bloc, restoking fears of a divided Europe.
The GAC statement said the mission would report to the next meeting of foreign ministers on February 24.
